text.tspan: Prevalence of anxiety disorders vs. income inequality, 2019
Share of the total population suffering from anxiety disorders. The Gini coefficient is a measure of the inequality of the income distribution in a
population. Higher values indicate a higher level of inequality.
Share of population with anxiety disorders
Data source: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2019); World Bank PIP
Note: Depending on the country and year, inequality data relates to either disposable income or consumption per capita.
